name: Bench Press
description: Lie on a flat bench and press a barbell from chest level until your arms are straight.
tips: Keep your feet flat, shoulder blades pinched together, and lower the bar to mid-chest.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
description: Press dumbbells upward on a bench set at about 30 degrees to target the upper chest.
tips: Do not flare your elbows past 45 degrees; control the weight on the way down.

name: Push-Up
description: A body-weight press from the floor that works chest, shoulders and triceps.
tips: Keep your body in one straight line from head to heels.

name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
description: Open your arms wide with dumbbells on a flat bench, then bring them together over your chest.
tips: Keep a slight bend in the elbows and use lighter weight than for presses.

name: Cable Crossover
description: Pull two high cable handles down and together in front of your body.
tips: Squeeze your chest at the bottom and avoid swinging your torso.

name: Deadlift
description: Lift a barbell from the floor to hip height by driving through your legs and extending the hips.
tips: Keep the bar close to your shins and your back flat throughout.

name: Pull-Up
description: Hang from a bar and pull your chin above it using your back and arms.
tips: Start from a full hang and avoid kicking or swinging.

name: Barbell Row
description: Hinge forward and row a barbell toward your lower ribs.
tips: Keep your back flat and pull the elbows back, not just the hands.

name: Lat Pulldown
description: Pull a wide bar down to your upper chest while seated at a cable machine.
tips: Lean back slightly and think about pulling with the elbows.

name: Seated Cable Row
description: Pull a cable handle toward your stomach while sitting upright.
tips: Do not rock back; pause briefly when your shoulder blades squeeze together.

name: Barbell Squat
description: Lower your hips with a barbell on your upper back, then stand up again.
tips: Keep your knees in line with your toes and your chest up.

name: Leg Press
description: Push a weighted platform away with your feet while seated on a machine.
tips: Never lock your knees fully at the top.

name: Walking Lunges
description: Step forward and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees, then step through.
tips: Take a long enough step so your front knee stays above your ankle.

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: Hinge at the hips with slightly bent knees to lower a barbell along your legs.
tips: Feel the stretch in your hamstrings and keep your back neutral.

name: Leg Curl
description: Curl a padded lever toward your glutes to work the hamstrings.
tips: Move slowly and avoid lifting your hips off the pad.

name: Standing Calf Raise
description: Rise onto your toes with weight on your shoulders or in your hands.
tips: Pause at the top and lower fully for a deep stretch.

name: Overhead Press
description: Press a barbell from your shoulders to above your head while standing.
tips: Tighten your core and glutes so you do not lean back.

name: Lateral Raise
description: Raise dumbbells out to your sides until your arms are parallel to the floor.
tips: Lead with the elbows and use a light weight.

name: Front Raise
description: Lift dumbbells straight in front of you to shoulder height.
tips: Avoid swinging; stop when your arms are level with your shoulders.

name: Face Pull
description: Pull a rope attachment toward your face with elbows high.
tips: Great for rear delts and posture; keep the weight moderate.

name: Arnold Press
description: A dumbbell press that rotates your palms from facing you to facing forward.
tips: Move smoothly and keep your ribs down.

name: Barbell Bicep Curl
description: Curl a barbell from thigh level up to your shoulders.
tips: Keep your elbows by your sides and do not swing your back.

name: Hammer Curl
description: Curl dumbbells with your palms facing each other.
tips: Works the brachialis and forearms; keep your wrists straight.

name: Tricep Pushdown
description: Push a cable bar or rope down until your arms are straight.
tips: Pin your elbows to your sides and squeeze at the bottom.

name: Skull Crusher
description: Lie on a bench and lower a bar toward your forehead by bending the elbows, then extend.
tips: Keep upper arms still and use a spotter for heavy sets.

name: Preacher Curl
description: Curl a weight while your upper arms rest on an angled pad.
tips: Lower slowly and do not fully lock out at the bottom.

name: Plank
description: Hold a straight body position on your forearms and toes.
tips: Squeeze your glutes and do not let your hips sag.

name: Crunch
description: Lie on your back and curl your shoulders toward your hips.
tips: Exhale as you curl up and keep your neck relaxed.

name: Russian Twist
description: Sit leaning back and rotate your torso side to side.
tips: Lift your feet for an extra challenge and twist from the ribs.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
description: Hang from a bar and lift your legs until they are parallel to the floor.
tips: Avoid swinging and curl your pelvis up at the top.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
description: Roll a wheel forward from your knees and pull back using your abs.
tips: Keep your lower back from arching; only roll as far as you can control.
